english:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. Heat dissipates each second by the displayed Cooling Efficiency value, even while stowed. Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and making the weapon unusable until Heat drops to 150 or below.

Cancelling a Manual Vent at 125 Heat or below grants 'Dynamic Heat Limiter', decreasing Heat Generation by 50% for 5 seconds. Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

Gaining the buff by cancelling the Vent through reloading or starting a sprint freezes its timer until the next time you fire the weapon, provided you dealt damage with the weapon before starting that Vent.

Primary Ammo Dynamic Heat Weapons deal increased direct damage based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File: 15%
• Elites, Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles: 38%
• Guardians: 2.5%

source.text:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. 
Passively dissipates Heat equal to the displayed Cooling Efficiency value each second, even while stowed.
Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and rendering the weapon unusable until its Heat is ≤150.

Upon cancelling a Manual Vent while Heat is ≤125:
Dynamic Heat Limiter | -50% Heat Generation for 5 seconds or until stowing the weapon.
Triggering Dynamic Heat Limiter through reload or sprint after having dealt damage will freeze the timer until shooting.

Primary Ammo Dynamic Heat Weapons intrinsically deal 15% Increased Impact Damage to Rank-and-File, and 38% Increased Impact Damage to Elites, Mini-bosses, Bosses, and Vehicles.
Additionally, they deal 2.5% increased direct damage to Guardians.

Additional information regarding Heat Weapons.
